units.source_text: 聚集于此的一伙人告辞出去，随即赴三条院向三公主贺岁。

en.t: The group gathered there took their leave and at once went to Sanjo-in to offer New Year's greetings to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 对朱雀院有旧情的人、六条院源氏方面的人，凡各种关系的人，都不忘记这位尼僧三公主，齐来贺年。

en.t: People with old ties to Emperor Suzaku, people connected with Genji of Rokujo-in, and all others bound to her in various ways did not forget the Third Princess, now a nun, but came together to pay their New Year's respects.

units.source_text: 髭黑大臣家的公子左近中将、右中弁、藤侍从等，就从自邸陪伴夕雾大臣同行。

en.t: The sons of Minister Higekuro's household, including the Sakon Middle Captain, the Right Middle Controller, and To no Jiju, accompanied Minister Yugiri from his residence.

units.source_text: 冠盖齐集，气势好不盛大！

en.t: Carriages and caps of high rank gathered in full array, making a truly splendid display.
